name: aixflow-community-bot
description: AIXFLOW 社群欢迎分流（微信桌面 RPA：截图 OCR + 拟人输入）

scripts.bridge:test: node --input-type=module -e "import { handleCommunityEvent } from './core.mjs'; const r=await handleCommunityEvent({userId:'t',displayName:'测',isNewJoin:true}); if(!Array.isArray(r.messages)||!r.messages.length) process.exit(1); console.log('bridge-ok', r.kind, r.messages.length, r.llm?'llm':'template');"
scripts.llm:fallback-test: node --input-type=module -e "process.env.COMMUNITY_LLM_ENABLED='0'; import { handleCommunityEvent } from './core.mjs'; const w=await handleCommunityEvent({userId:'fb_w',displayName:'测',isNewJoin:true}); const i=await handleCommunityEvent({userId:'fb_w',displayName:'测',text:'1'}); if(w.llm||i.llm) process.exit(2); if(!w.messages[0].includes('欢迎')||!i.messages[0].includes('下载')) { console.error(w,i); process.exit(1);} console.log('fallback-ok', w.kind, i.kind, i.intent);"
